name: Jia Jun Jie
bio:
Jia Jun's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Singapore, focusing on vehicle dynamics and data analysis. While studying, he volunteered with a local karting team, gaining invaluable experience in vehicle preparation and driver support. 

His analytical mind and meticulous nature made him a perfect fit for a test driver coordinator. At RSC Motorsport, Jia Jun is responsible for planning and executing test sessions, analyzing driver feedback, and translating it into actionable improvements for the race engineers. He prides himself on his ability to identify subtle nuances in driver performance and correlate them to specific vehicle setups. What sets him apart is his proactive approach; he's always looking for innovative testing methodologies to extract the most value from every track session.

 Jia Jun is a strong believer in constant improvement and is always pushing himself and the team to achieve better results. He's a quiet but highly respected member of the team, known for his dedication and unwavering commitment to performance.
